gtk::Button (.flat) + gtk::Revealer (slide-down) -- matches existing expand/collapse pattern
Red badge always visible in collapsed state. Error rows highlighted with red bg + red left border when expanded.
All consecutive tool calls between text messages = one burst. Single isolated tool calls render normally (no card).
Generated from tool names + preview data. Up to 3 items, then "and N more". Truncated at ~80 chars.
Tab to burst header, Space/Enter to toggle. When expanded, Tab into individual rows and inspect buttons.
Button label: "8 tool calls, 1 error, activate to expand". Revealer hides content from screen reader when collapsed.
